name: BeatScope Rhythm Project
description: Deterministic rhythm intermediate representation. Facts (beats, onsets, energy) are separated from derived semantics (tempo, grid, patterns, cues). Instrument identity (kick, snare, hihat, 808) is intentionally absent, and signal strength is never renamed to confidence.

source.sha256: content hash of the analysed audio

analysis.provenance: per-fact method declaration; beats and onsets must declare a 'method'
analysis.diagnostics: interpretable extras: pregrid_beats_merged, migrated_from, legacy_tempo_score, variable_tempo

tempo.segments: list of {start, end, bpm, method, score} - score may be null

top_level_fields.beats: ordered list of {time, index, bar (1-based), beat_in_bar (1-based), downbeat}
top_level_fields.onsets: ordered list of {id, time, strength, bands: {all, low, mid, high}, accent?} - strength is signal strength, not confidence

energy.bands: {all|low|mid|high: list of 0..1} - omitted from MCP timing/summary responses

patterns.bars: list of {bar, label, group, mean_strength, similarity_previous, vector}

top_level_fields.cues: dict of accent|impact|scale|flow|flash|bloom -> list of {time, onset?}

validation: beatscope.schema.validate_rhythm_v4 returns a list of error strings; an empty list means valid
